dogecoin.text: Not that I think Elon has a fiduciary responsibility to praise dogecoin, not that I think investing money you can’t afford to lose in dogecoin is a smart, safe way to manage your money, but people do lots of stupid and dangerous things in a job market this bleak...
When people on r/dogecoin start un-ironically dropping the s****** hotline in the thread after Elon calls it a hustle, it really says something about this world
